msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all cell types residing in Loose Areolar Connective Tissue matrix: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: Areolar CT matrix contains fibroblasts, mast cells, histocytes, and plasma cells.

From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all anatomical structures containing Hyaline Cartilage: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Articular ends of long bones
answers: A) Articular ends of long bones
msqs.explanation: Hyaline cartilage lines articular ends, nose, ribs, and tracheal rings.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all true statements regarding White Fat vs Brown Fat: (Select all that apply)
options: A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular
B) Brown fat contains dense cytochrome mitochondria for thermogenesis
D) White fat serves as primary energy storage and thermal insulation
E) White fat generates heat in hibernating newborn mammals
answers: A) White adipocytes are monolocular; Brown adipocytes are multilocular
B) Brown fat contains dense cytochrome mitochondria for thermogenesis
D) White fat serves as primary energy storage and thermal insulation
msqs.explanation: Brown fat is multilocular, rich in mitochondria/UCP-1 for heat generation; White fat is monolocular energy storage.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all components forming a Compact Bone Osteon: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Central Haversian canal containing blood vessels and nerve
answers: A) Central Haversian canal containing blood vessels and nerve
msqs.explanation: Osteons consist of Haversian canals, concentric lamellae, lacunae with osteocytes, and canaliculi.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all formed blood elements: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: Formed blood elements comprise RBCs, WBCs, and Platelets.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all tissue macrophages derived from blood monocytes: (Select all that apply)
options: C) Dust cells / alveolar macrophages of lungs
answers: C) Dust cells / alveolar macrophages of lungs
msqs.explanation: Monocyte-derived histocytes: Kupffer cells, Microglia, Dust cells, and Langerhans cells.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all characteristics distinguishing Fibrocartilage from Elastic Cartilage: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Fibrocartilage contains thick Type I collagen bundles
C) Fibrocartilage resists high mechanical compression in intervertebral discs
D) Elastic cartilage contains branching yellow elastin fibers in pinna and epiglottis
E) Elastic cartilage has highest tensile strength among all cartilages
answers: A) Fibrocartilage contains thick Type I collagen bundles
C) Fibrocartilage resists high mechanical compression in intervertebral discs
D) Elastic cartilage contains branching yellow elastin fibers in pinna and epiglottis
msqs.explanation: Fibrocartilage has Type I collagen, lacks perichondrium, absorbs shock in discs. Elastic cartilage has elastin in ear/epiglottis.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all plasma proteins maintaining blood physiology: (Select all that apply)
msqs.explanation: Plasma proteins include Albumin, Globulin, Fibrinogen, and Prothrombin. Hemoglobin is inside RBCs.

msqs.stem: From Question Bank perspective, in Topic 3, select all types of Dense Connective Tissue: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT (Tendons)
B) Dense Irregular White Collagenous CT (Dermis of skin)
C) Yellow Elastic CT (Artery walls & Ligaments)
answers: A) Dense Regular White Fibrous CT (Tendons)
B) Dense Irregular White Collagenous CT (Dermis of skin)
C) Yellow Elastic CT (Artery walls & Ligaments)
msqs.explanation: Dense CT categories: Dense Regular, Dense Irregular, and Elastic CT. Areolar and Adipose are Loose CT.
